name: shiplog
description: Automatic work tracking for developers: collect what you actually did across Azure DevOps and GitHub, then ask about it in plain language.

plugins.name: shiplog
plugins.description: Track and query your own PRs, commits, tickets, reviews and deployments across Azure DevOps and GitHub. Synced nightly into local SQLite, then answered in plain language for standups, one-on-ones and performance reviews.
